name: renegade-ml-js
description: WebAssembly bindings for the Renegade machine learning library

scripts.build:node: wasm-pack build --release --target nodejs --out-dir dist/node --out-name renegade && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/node/.gitignore', { force: true })"
scripts.build:web: wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir dist/web --out-name renegade && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/web/.gitignore', { force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:web
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
